summary: The permanent-injunction case. After a jury finds willful infringement, the E.D. Va. denies MercExchange a permanent injunction; the Federal Circuit reverses that denial as part of a mixed judgment; eBay wins certiorari. Exercises FRCP -> Federal Circuit (cafc@district-court) and the panel-mixed flag through rehearing and certiorari.

legs.context: MercExchange sues eBay and Half.com for infringing its online-auction patents (E.D. Va.); trial began 2003-04-23.

steps.event: Jury finds willful infringement and awards $35.0M
Defendants renew their JMOL motions (new-trial motions were also filed; the pack takes one motion at a time)
JMOL and new trial denied (inducement award set aside); permanent injunction denied; judgment for $29.5M
A patent case goes to the Federal Circuit (28 U.S.C. § 1295(a)(1)), not the Fourth Circuit
The notice of appeal, as the CAFC pack records it
Appeal docketed at the Federal Circuit
Entries of appearance and certificates of interest
No stay motion in the sources read (route assumed)
Cross-appeal docketed with the lead appeal
Argued (date not in the sources read; route assumed)
Affirmed in part, reversed in part (including reversing the injunction denial), vacated in part, and remanded (Bryson, J.)
Bill of costs (route assumed; the pack requires it)
Certiorari granted, with an added question on Continental Paper Bag

gaps.event: Supreme Court vacates and remands (argued 2006-03-29, decided 2006-05-15, unanimous): the four-factor equitable test governs patent injunctions
gaps.why: No pack models Supreme Court merits review; cert-granted is terminal.

deadlines.arithmetic: FRAP 4(a)(1)(A): 30 days. Aug 6 + 25 = Aug 31; + 5 = Sep 5 (30), a Friday.
deadlines.historical: Notice-of-appeal date not found; the appeal is No. 03-1600, docketed in 2003.

deadlines.arithmetic: Fed. Cir. R. 40: 30 days (no U.S. party). Mar 16 + 15 = Mar 31; + 15 = Apr 15 (30), a Friday.
deadlines.historical: The petition was denied 2005-04-26; its filing date was not found. The pack encodes the current Federal Circuit rule; the period in force in 2005 was not checked.
Petition filed 2005-07-25, on the last day.

quirks: The notice of appeal is one filing but two edges: FRCP's notice-of-appeal-filed, and the CAFC pack's own district-court-file-noa after the link. Both carry the 30-day FRAP 4(a) window.

The FRCP pack does not model the permanent-injunction motion (FRCP 65 / 35 U.S.C. § 283) separately from the post-trial motions, so the injunction denial, which was the issue on certiorari, is folded into the post-trial ruling step.
The CAFC pack's panel-to-mixed has no remand branch; the real judgment also vacated in part and remanded (the '051 patent).
The CAFC pack tags cert-granted with outcome 'remand'; the FRAP pack tags the same event 'pending'.
The CAFC pack requires a bill-of-costs step before the certiorari window.
